name: Being Assertive
overview: Scripture encourages believers to exercise assertiveness grounded in integrity and humility, as seen in Matthew 5:37 where clear and honest communication is mandated. Being assertive involves confidently standing firm, exemplified by the instruction in Luke 10:10 to decisively move on when rejected. At the same time, assertiveness is balanced with patience and gentleness, as James 1:19 advises believers to be quick to listen and slow to speak or anger. This balance reflects the call in Genesis 4:7 to rule over sin with self-control, and the Golden Rule in Luke 6:31 reminds us to treat others as we desire, guiding assertive actions with love and respect.
